grounding.observation: Actual c2 rejection and exact original source/reference roles are carried into correction3.
grounding.comparison: The previous cone and bodysuit are negative controls, not acceptable foundations.

expert_coverage.observation: Cloth construction, material response, animated beard ownership and camera visibility have concrete methods and proofs.
expert_coverage.comparison: Temporary close views expose otherwise concealed defects but cannot replace the actual shot frames or final motion review.

film_alignment.observation: Broad cloth planes and separated short-coat response target the accepted film's dimensional/material quality without changing lighting or the accepted co-star.
film_alignment.comparison: Procedural folds can still look manufactured; the five images must reject that result rather than crediting the new method.

preferences.observation: The proof remains internal, with no demand for Director algorithm approval and no full-sequence rerender.
preferences.comparison: A stronger silhouette alone does not justify a completed-package handoff.

reference_roles.observation: The tall wrapped silhouette is evaluated against the actual reference; the accepted still remains a quality comparator, not an identity or motion source.
reference_roles.comparison: No production shot or original reference role is changed by diagnostic cameras.

method.observation: Code changes have been inspected: broad distinct courses replace constant-pitch winding; cloth envelope bridges anatomy; beard repair spans inertial shape keys; the existing UV coat is retained.53 focused tests pass.
method.comparison: Those tests establish numerical and input boundaries, not convincing cloth, facial hair or animal appearance. Actual visible output is the discriminating control.

interfaces.observation: Same candidate5 parent preserves primary motion; sash refit and pad remain explicit contact tests. Temporary camera is removed in a finally block and its view/matrix are recorded.
interfaces.comparison: Crest, cuffs, neck, beard roots, saddle and reverse must be inspected. No static fit is promoted to moving contact acceptance.

efficient_quality.observation: Two actors and five revealing images precede propagation. Previously occluded crowd evidence is replaced rather than counted as a pass.
efficient_quality.comparison: Full-speed evidence remains pending; no percentage efficiency claim or reduction of the accepted quality floor follows.

authority.observation: Correction3/max4 retains both earlier failures and the original allowance. Existing supporting appearance, dark horse and local evidence only.
authority.comparison: No principal identity, new spending, tool installation, cloud, upload, publication or release authority is inferred.

strongest_counterexample: Broad courses and a looser envelope can still produce a sculpted hat and inflated shirt. The proof must reject those forms, not merely recognize that code changed. A diagnostic camera that misses its target also fails evidence.
